test_cases.title: Verify login with valid registered credentials authenticates the user

steps.action: Enter a valid registered account email into the Email field
steps.expected: The email value is accepted in the Email field with no validation error.
steps.actual: Entered value into 'a valid registered account email into the email field' input field successfully.

steps.action: Enter the valid account password into the Password field
steps.expected: The password value is accepted and masked in the Password field with no validation error.
steps.actual: Entered value into 'the valid account password into the password field' input field successfully.

steps.action: Click the Login button to submit the credentials
steps.expected: The credentials are submitted and the authentication request is processed.
steps.actual: Clicked component 'the login button to submit the credentials' successfully.

steps.action: Verify the resulting authenticated state after submission
steps.expected: The user is redirected away from the login form to their account or home area and an authenticated-session indicator such as the account menu becomes visible.
steps.actual: Failed executing step interaction: Authentication was not confirmed — the page is still on the login/auth screen (url=https://webook.com/en/login, login form fields present=True). Expected navigation away from login and the login form to disappear.

test_cases.expected_result: The system behavior conforms to the acceptance criterion: 'login with valid registered credentials authenticates the user'. The UI reflects the expected state with no errors or console warnings.
